purpose: Pair frozen and online M under one preregistered M-adjusted family-relative candidate score to test whether a lawful reliability update can affect anonymous causal actions.

scorer.family_standardization: population mean/std within existing and Known families, then existing peak wins ties

selection_rule: Use the first two frozen policy-order videos and first eight metadata clock frames of each; initialize both arms with the same seed and update only the online arm at the first eligible fixed-scope M opportunity, without selecting an arm or stopping on an outcome.
interpretation: This is a bounded causal decision-effect control for the M-gated candidate scorer. It is not calibrated self-correcting memory, predicted-track training, an OCD/MOT metric, model selection, or Goal A/B/C acceptance.
